run_preprocess_bold5000: run the script to preprocess BOLD5000 fMRI DICOM data into event sequences saved as NPZ
review_preprocess_bold5000: review the BOLD5000 preprocessing script that computes z-scores and extracts threshold-crossing events from DICOM volumes
summarize_preprocess_bold5000: summarize the script that reads BOLD5000 DICOM files, computes voxel z-scores, and splits events into ten normalized sequences
refactor_preprocess_bold5000: refactor the BOLD5000 preprocessing script to parameterize the z-score threshold and output path instead of hardcoding them
test_preprocess_bold5000: test the BOLD5000 preprocessing pipeline by running it on a single session directory and verifying NPZ output
